works.title: Glowgrot
works.desc: A sporekeeper's vigil beneath the oldest forest. Five living towers guard the Heartspore through 24 waves of the Dusk Tide.

works.title: Dream Defenders
works.desc: Slumber Siege — five dream guardians (stars, moon orbs, snuggle bears, nimbus chains, rainbow beams) hold the bed against 25 waves of nightmares.

works.title: Picnic Panic!
works.desc: Defend your picnic basket from hungry bugs. Five tower types, random maps, upgrades, and 20 waves of critter chaos.

works.title: Marginalia
works.desc: Hold the Ink Road of a drowned town that survives only on its 1687 chart. Five living map decorations, twenty dated blights of paper, a new hand-drawn chart every game.

works.title: Bubble Reef TD
works.desc: Underwater defense. Coral towers, seafoam waves, pearl economy. Defend the reef.

works.title: Excel TD
works.desc: Spreadsheet tower defense. Place towers in cells. Defend the budget. =SUM(enemies).

works.title: 3 AM — Sleep Defense
works.desc: Dreamy midnight defense. Hold back the insomnia until dawn with soothing sleep towers.

works.title: Tidepool Tactics
works.desc: Defend the roe in one magnified drop of seawater. A live tide clock flips enemy speed & tower bonuses across 24 waves — five microbe heroes, four upgrades each.

works.title: Lampblack
works.desc: Grimy deep-pit defense where light is the weapon. Every machine throws a lumen field — anything standing outside one is shrouded, faster and half-immune. Five machines, four upgrades each, a random rail line and 25 named shifts.

works.title: Kingdom's Last Stand
works.desc: Defend the realm. Upgrade towers, hold the castle. One last stand against the horde.

works.title: Abyssal Bloom
works.desc: Bioluminescent deep-sea defense. Five glowing reef towers guard the Heart through 20 waves of abyssal creatures.

works.title: Clockwork Defense
works.desc: Steampunk gears vs gadgets. Five clockwork towers — Tesla coils, cogpults, chronoblasters — hold the line across 20 waves.

works.title: Ink & Ash
works.desc: Defend the last living book from the Redaction. Five scriptorium towers — quill, inkwell, red pen, gilder & the great press — each with four upgrades, across 24 named waves.

works.title: 3D FPS Tower Defense
works.desc: First-person 3D. Place towers, aim and shoot. Defend from the ground in immersive 3D.

works.title: Pastel Defense
works.desc: 5 Towers. Clean lines. Minimalist strategy. Hold the line with precision placement.

works.title: Emoji Tower Defense
works.desc: Emoji towers on grass and dirt. Place defenses, stop the waves. Defend with style.

works.title: Slime Garden Defense
works.desc: Cute slime towers vs hungry garden bugs. Procedural tracks, 5 customizable slimes with 4 upgrades, and 20 waves.

works.title: Sprout & Slime Defense
works.desc: Woodland critter defense with random winding tracks, 5 customizable towers, 4 upgrades each, Web Audio sound synth, and 20 waves of cute slimes.

works.title: Chrono-Mycelium
works.desc: Bio-acoustic fungal defense vs subterranean Dissonance Swarm. Procedural winding spline tracks, 5 towers with 4 upgrade tiers, Web Audio synth, and 20 narrative waves.

works.title: Codex Imperium
works.desc: Victorian steam-press defense on living vellum. 5 brass typecasting engines with 4 upgrade tiers, procedural Web Audio acoustic synth, and 20 waves of ink-born errata.

works.title: Essentia
works.desc: Victorian spagyric perfumery defense in Grasse 1888. 5 alembic stills with 4 upgrade tiers each, procedural spline tracks, Web Audio sound synthesis, and 20 watches of creeping malodors.

works.title: The Atlas That Drew Itself
works.desc: Cartomancer's defense on living parchment. Five drafting-tool towers — quill, sextant, wind rose, compass & Paperweight Mt. — hold the map against 20 waves of ink-born Unwritten.

works.title: Harmony Hollow
works.desc: Animal musicians defend the Songbird's nest from the creeping Hush. Five bandmate towers, four upgrades each, random winding tracks, 20 waves — every shot plays a real note.

works.title: Candy Circuit TD
works.desc: Sweet circuits. Candy towers, pastel paths. No dependencies. Pure vanilla defense.

works.title: Bubble Bastion Defense
works.desc: Hold the bastion. Bubble towers, sunny skies. Defend with strategy and style.

works.title: Meadow Guard TD
works.desc: Cartoony meadow defense with random tracks, five tower families, and intermission upgrades between waves.

works.title: Moonberry Meadow
works.desc: Storybook night-picnic defense with random trails, five woodland towers, four upgrades each, and 24 handcrafted waves.

works.title: Mourningbloom
works.desc: Gothic nursery defense for the last moonseed — random gardens, ward towers, and 24 funeral-wave processions.

works.title: Jam Jar Jamboree
works.desc: Storybook picnic defense with a fresh random blanket path, five snack-stopping pals, four upgrades each, and 24 waves.

works.title: The Rainkeeper
works.desc: The last ocean lives inside a glass snail. Keep the small weather with five curious instruments, four refits each, and 24 fronts of living drought on a random illustrated atlas.

works.title: Mycelia
works.desc: Guardians of the glowing grove. Five mushroom towers defend the Heartspore across 22 waves of fungal blight.

works.title: Spin Cycle Skies
works.desc: Dream laundromat defense. Random stitched tracks, five tower kits, and 24 whimsical wash-cycle waves.

works.title: Terra Incognita
works.desc: The map does not describe the world — the world obeys the map. Five Guild instruments, four inscriptions each, and 24 expeditions of the Unmapped.

works.title: Whimsical Defense
works.desc: Fantasy towers. Archer, Cannon, Ice, Lightning, Poison. Defend the realm.

works.title: The Last Broadcast
works.desc: Night-operator radio defense on a random signal-cable track. Five transmitter towers, four tunings each, and 24 watches of the Hollow Hours until dawn.

works.title: Critter Towers
works.desc: Cute critters, friendly towers. Defend your garden with charm and strategy.

works.title: Cutey Defense
works.desc: Cute garden defense. Place daisies, cactus blasters, ice cream freezers, owls, and sparkle wizards.

works.title: Dreamland Defense
works.desc: Protect the Realm of Dreams. Place dream towers along the glowing path and survive 20 waves.

works.title: Nightmare Nursery
works.desc: Gothic nursery defense with dreamland towers — pillow blasters, lullaby bells, stuffed snipers, ink blooms, and shadow hugs — surviving 25 nightmare waves.

works.title: Shadowpuff Siege
works.desc: Cute cartoony gloomy defense. Five shadowpuff towers defend the Hearthfire against 20 waves of creeping gloom.

works.title: Stitchlight Defense
works.desc: A living quilt in the pastel sky. Five sewing-kit towers, random seam-paths, and 24 waves of Unravelers between cozy upgrade intermissions.

works.title: Stormglass
works.desc: Defend the last sealed storm glass. Five meteorological instruments, four retunes each, a random density-current, and 24 watches of Unweather.

works.title: SPOREFALL
works.desc: Roam an endless bioluminescent fungal vale of glowcap mushrooms, lantern wisps, and rune monoliths beneath twin moons.
works.subtitle: Mycelium Vale

works.title: KNOTSIDE
works.desc: Walk the back of the world’s tapestry: spindle groves, leaning needle stones, knot-hills, shuttlewrens and dropped stitches glowing with light from a picture no one has ever seen.
works.subtitle: Wrong Side

works.title: Bioluminescent Depths
works.desc: Wander an alien mushroom forest aglow with cyan fungi, purple crystals, and floating spores in the dark.
works.subtitle: Deep Glow

works.title: Luminous Depths
works.desc: Explore bioluminescent caverns. Discover glowing caves and hidden underground wonders.
works.subtitle: Crystal Delve

works.title: LUMENGROVE
works.desc: Wander a twilight alien grove of glowing mushrooms, faceted crystal spires, and drifting spore-jellies beneath twin moons.
works.subtitle: Lumen Drift

works.title: THE CHOIRWOOD
works.desc: Wander the stretched vellum of a drum the size of a country, where gramophone bells, organ pipes and humming tuning forks took root instead of trees—and the skin rings out beneath every step.
works.subtitle: Held Note

works.title: Bioluminescent Deep Sea Drift
works.desc: Dive into the dark depths. Explore glowing underwater worlds and mysterious sea creatures.
works.subtitle: Abyss Trial

works.title: CANDYFALL
works.desc: Wander an endless candy-coated dreamscape of swirling lollipop trees, gumdrop groves, and peppermint spires beneath a cotton-candy sky.
works.subtitle: Sugar Trek

works.title: STORMGLASS
works.desc: Wander an endless frozen tempest of glass lightning, suspended rain, petrified thunderstones, and storm-ring gates beneath a calm storm-eye.
works.subtitle: Frozen Tempest

works.title: Bioluminescent Fungi Forest
works.desc: Roam a glowing mushroom forest lit by magical spores and otherworldly neon flora.
works.subtitle: Mystic Grove

works.title: Haunted Forest 3D
works.desc: Wander through spooky woods in first-person. Endless procedurally generated trees and glowing mushrooms.
works.subtitle: Forest Quest

works.title: Neon Cyberpunk Undercity
works.desc: Drop into a glowing undercity of monoliths, pyramids, and electric spires rendered entirely with SVG.
works.subtitle: Neon Run

works.title: Aetherial Clockwork Garden
works.desc: Wander an endless steampunk dreamscape of brass gear trees, glowing steam vents, and clockwork lampposts under a mechanical sky.
works.subtitle: Clockwork Garden

works.title: LUMINA GROVE
works.desc: Explore an endless bioluminescent crystal forest of neon spires, layered alien canopy trees, glowing spore fungi, and floating ancient monoliths in pure SVG.
works.subtitle: Lumina Grove

works.title: AETHERIA
works.desc: Wander an endless bioluminescent astral forest of glowing prism spires, willow canopies, aether sprites, and ancient resonance relics in pure SVG.
works.subtitle: Astral Aether

works.title: CHRONOSTRATA
works.desc: Traverse an endless petrified seabed beneath fractured planetary rings, discovering colossal clockwork orreries, resonance spires, and seraph automata in pure SVG.
works.subtitle: Petrified Orrery

works.title: Kintsugi Dunes
works.desc: Wander an endless twilight desert of porcelain dunes veined with molten gold, jade lantern trees, broken ring gates, and drifting paper cranes.
works.subtitle: Gilded Trek

works.title: Shattersea Drift
works.desc: Sail across the endless seas. Navigate through waves and discover what lies beyond the horizon.
works.subtitle: Pirate Voyage

works.title: Glasswood Drift
works.desc: Explore an endless aurora forest of prism pines, lantern blooms, ribbon arches, and drifting sky-kites.
works.subtitle: Aurora Trek

works.title: Prism Mycelium
works.desc: Step into a glassy fungal world of aurora skies, crystal arches, luminous towers, and drifting seed-creatures.
works.subtitle: Prism Mycelium

works.title: LUMENWOOD
works.desc: Walk an endless lunar forest of singing spires, glass lanterns, glowcap mushrooms, and moonlit stones in pure SVG.
works.subtitle: Moonlit Trail

works.title: VESPERGLASS
works.desc: Walk an endless alien twilight of bell trees, tuning arches, helix reeds, and floating veil-rays beneath a ringed moon.
works.subtitle: Listening Wilds

works.title: The Glassroot Choir
works.desc: Wander an endless mycelial dreamsea of glassroot arches, choir blooms, and aurora veins in pure first-person SVG.
works.subtitle: Choir Drift

works.title: Auralis Drift
works.desc: Explore an endless glass-sand wind garden of sail trees, whistle blooms, prism cairns, and drifting raylings in pure SVG.
works.subtitle: Wind Garden

works.title: Porcelain Tide
works.desc: Walk an endless porcelain orchard on the bed of a vanished ocean. Follow ringing Brinebells, discover shell archives, and recover six memories to return the tide.
works.subtitle: A Quiet Expedition

works.title: Chroma Tidelands
works.desc: Explore an endless pure-SVG alien tideflat of prism mangroves, resonance arches, shard blooms, and drifting bell creatures.
works.subtitle: Chroma Trek

works.title: Lumina Drift
works.desc: Drift through a glowing intercellular world of membranes, luminous organelles, and pulsing mitochondria—a bioluminescent odyssey in pure SVG.
works.subtitle: Cellular Drift

works.title: VESPERFEN
works.desc: Walk the hour-before-dawn across a mirror-water fen of humming songstalks, rune monoliths, and drowned chapels whose dark rose-windows wait for a keeper to relight them.
works.subtitle: Mirror Shallows

works.title: Lumina Sporewood
works.desc: Wander an endless pure-SVG bioluminescent night forest of glowing capstalks, lantern trees, and floating spore jellies under twin moons.
works.subtitle: Spore Trek

works.title: CAMEWOOD
works.desc: Wander an endless gothic glasswood of leaded trees, rose-window blooms, reliquary spires, and candle-moths under a cathedral vault of stained night.
works.subtitle: Leaded Vespers

works.title: Changeover
works.desc: The last stagehand of a closing theater runs a forty-count scene change beside the house's pale memories of every pass already made. Contradict history and the stage manager calls a hold.

works.title: Paradox Vault
works.desc: Rob a vault by cooperating with your past selves. Every loop, your old inputs replay beside you — move one box they depended on and history tears open.

works.title: The Standing Salt
works.desc: Walk a 1670s salt-pan alone, beside four shifts of hardened salt repeating your earlier work exactly. Weight the tread-boards, shoulder the loaves, carry the mother to the crib. Contradict what you already did and the salt slakes.

works.title: The Organist's Ledger
works.desc: Sustain cathedral air pressure across deterministic measures. Coordinate prior verses, manage pedal valves, and prevent dissonant ruptures.

works.title: The Repeater at Pont-Neuf
works.desc: In the 1897 pneumatic sorting vault of Paris, spool punched copper ribbons into Maelzel Automata to hold vacuum treadles, shove wicker hampers, and transmit imperial dispatches — deviate from recorded paper and the escapements shear.

works.title: The Loom That Ate the Dawn
works.desc: Finish a dead weaver's last dawn beside Woven Figures made from your prior footfalls. Hold treadles, seat boat-shuttles, and protect every older stitch from a Snarl.

works.title: Jack in the Green
works.desc: Midsummer Eve on a village green. Each rehearsal you dance, the turf keeps and replays beside you as a Footfall of blossom-light. Roll the wain, hold the flowered marks, crown the pole with the garland — cross a worn step and the ribbons knot.

works.title: Actias
works.desc: You are the last luna moth, seven nights old, flying the drowned road to the Moon. Snuff the lying lights, slip the webs and wires — and do not trust the lighthouse.

works.title: Weftrunner
works.desc: The world is a cloth on the Great Loom. Fly the weft toward the Beam, stitch down the moths eating it, and outrun the unravelling closing from behind.

works.title: Gildwake
works.desc: Ride a restoration brush across a falling porcelain world — bind living cobalt with gold, dodge unbreakable relief, and outrun the fracture.

works.title: Redline Ascent
works.desc: Blast through a scorched pseudo-3D wasteland. Thread ruined arches, crush attack waves, and manage your weapon heat.

works.title: The Last Stroke
works.desc: You are a koi of living ink racing up a dying hand-painted scroll. Cut down brush-stroke demons with water beads, weave the bamboo — and dot the blind dragon's eye before the ink dries.

works.title: Parison
works.desc: You are the last breath inside a gather of molten glass, racing the cooling pipe toward the lip — burst the bubbles, weave the iron, and do not anneal.

works.title: Baseboard Bandit
works.desc: Tight-turn scooter action. Weave through obstacles at breakneck speed.

works.title: Genesis Colony
works.desc: Defend and grow an alien colony with orbital weapons, energy management, and prestige upgrades.

works.title: Life Lab
works.desc: Explore cellular automata rule variants in an interactive Game of Life sandbox.

works.title: Mosslight
works.desc: Tend a tiny 3D ecology where procedural creatures forage, reproduce, mutate, and evolve.

works.title: Mother OS Defense
works.desc: A green-screen tactical tower defense with unlimited waves, upgrades, and enemy intel.

works.title: Neon Ascent
works.desc: Bounce up an endless cyberpunk tower. Steer with mouse, arrows, or touch — collect shards, dodge drones.

works.title: Pale Blue Dot
works.desc: A narrative prototype set against the vastness of space. Prologue edition.

works.title: Blightspore
works.desc: Steer a multi-species cellular automaton on a 24x24 grid. Plant moss, dig firebreaks, and ignite controlled burns to clear the blight.

works.title: Canon Rebel T5i Trainer
works.desc: Interactive guide for learning Canon EOS Rebel T5i controls, shooting modes, exposure, autofocus, and quick field workflows.

works.title: China Population Density
works.desc: Interactive map of China’s 34 province-level divisions — people per km², major cities, and 2020 census stats with density and population color modes.

works.title: EU–U.S. Sentiment Atlas
works.desc: Interactive public-opinion atlas of how EU27 countries view the United States — image, leadership, reliability, and policy handling, with sources for every measure.

works.title: Freezing Water with Gas
works.desc: Interactive thermodynamics tutorial — ideal gas law, adiabatic expansion, refrigeration cycles, and a live simulator for freezing water with compressed gas.

works.title: Gonka, Explained
works.desc: Source-grounded explainer of David Liberman’s Decentralized AI white paper and the Gonka network design.

works.title: Hist Gradient Boosting
works.desc: Interactive explainer of histogram-based gradient boosting — binning, gradient histograms, split scanning, and boosted trees fitting live on toy data.

works.title: Shapley Value Estimation
works.desc: Interactive introduction to Shapley values in machine learning — coalitions, fair credit, permutation sampling, and KernelSHAP, taught on a live 3D lattice.

works.title: Strange Attractors
works.desc: The mathematics of strange attractors — phase space, stretching and folding, bifurcations, fractal dimension — explained visually, with interactive experiments.

works.title: SynthID-Text
works.desc: How Google DeepMind watermarks model output through keyed token sampling — tournament choices, statistical detection, non-distortion, thresholds, edits, and honest limits.

works.title: US Grid & Data Centers
works.desc: Interactive map overlay showing US data center locations, grid capacity, and energy infrastructure across time.

works.title: Text Steganography
works.desc: How secrets hide inside ordinary text — null ciphers, zero-width characters, synonym codes, and the censor’s scanner that catches them, with hands-on encoders under a UV lamp.

works.title: Key Driver Analysis
works.desc: Interactive tutorial on key driver analysis — correlation traps, standardized betas, Shapley importance, and the importance×performance quadrant, with a live survey sandbox.

works.title: Cellular Learning Automata
works.desc: Interactive explainer of emergent consensus through distributed reinforcement learning using Cellular Learning Automata.

works.title: Loop Engineering in Antigravity
works.desc: Interactive guide explaining autonomous AI decision cycles, safety guardrails, sandboxed assistant delegation, and persistent memory loops.

works.title: AI Design Palette
works.desc: Catalog of AI app and agentic tool design systems — typography, colors, and UI patterns from leading products.

works.title: App Adoption & Usage Model
works.desc: Cohort calculator for subscription-app growth — trial funnel, month-over-month retention, and how a heavy-using few drive most usage. Tuned with real fitness-app benchmarks.

works.title: Burpee Form Lab
works.desc: Interactive 3D form trainer showing burpee positions, cues, checklist steps, reps, and speed controls.

works.title: Phosphor Wake
works.desc: An original pixel monospace from a terminal that never slept. Two installable cuts, coding symbols, a live CRT tester, and a free font kit.

works.title: Sky & Weather
works.desc: Interactive weather and sky conditions infographic with real-time data visualization.

works.title: Text Steganography Decoder
works.desc: Deep text steganography forensic station — decodes invisible zero-width Unicode, homoglyphs, whitespace SNOW, null ciphers, and Baconian case with WebGL visual telemetry.

works.title: Archive Ember
works.desc: Paper grain, foxing, ink, char, embers, and smoke — one fragment shader burns an antique page inward from the corner, and the front never stops advancing.

works.title: Blood Splat Submit
works.desc: A plain HTML submit button takes a hit like a bug on a windshield — spatter squeezes out around it, coats the face, dries to a crust, and flakes away to dust before the button comes back to life.

works.title: Greenhouse Vines
works.desc: Five leafed strands grow around a dialog — some reading as in front of the glass, some behind it — so the frame weaves itself together from a single shader.

works.title: Holographic Formula Drift
works.desc: Procedural numerals and formula marks stream around a table’s rim, switching mid-flight and leaving blue phosphor afterimages. No texture atlas — every glyph is drawn from math.

works.title: Stillroom Shaft
works.desc: A dark, still room cut by one late-sun ray from the upper left — volumetric air that absorbs as well as it glows, and dust motes that wander freely and only catch when they pass through the beam.

works.title: Typewriter Letter Drift
works.desc: The border that types itself around the Learn index — letters bob through sepia haze, near ones inked sharp, far ones fading, each re-struck with a double-strike ghost.

works.title: Oregon Wheel
works.desc: Spin the wheel and see where fate takes you. A classic randomizer with a twist.

works.title: Slot Tracker
works.desc: Track spins, patterns, and streaks. A data-driven companion for the curious gambler.

works.title: Greenhouse To-Do
works.desc: Cultivate your tasks in a WebGL greenhouse. Completed items bloom into flowers; neglected ones wilt on a half-life.

works.title: Vector Defense
works.desc: Retro tactical missile command with terrain mechanics and a CRT military aesthetic.
